text.p: Tropical Cyclone Freda, with 50 mph winds, is southwest of the Fiji Islands in the southern Pacific near 22s/176e, moving east southeast at 7 mph. Freda is expected to intensify to near 60 mph this period while moving southeastward in the waters southwest of the Fiji Islands. It is a threat mainly to shipping.

Tropical Cyclone Gretelle, with 50 mph winds, is in the southwestern Indian Ocean, south southwest of Madagascar, near 25s/37e, moving southwest at 8 mph. Gretelle will slowly weaken but will be some threat to shipping in the waters well east of southeastern Africa.

Tropical Cyclone Pancho-Helinda, with 80 mph winds, is nearly stationary in the southern Indian Ocean near 15s/91e. Tropical Cyclone Iletta, with 50 mph winds, is also nearly stationary in the southern Indian Ocean near 14s/69e. Pancho-Helinda will weaken slightly, and Iletta may strengthen this period. Both storms threaten shipping but no major land areas. Both storms are expected to move little this period.
There are no further statements at this time.
